18 weeks, as squares.

The Home tab shows the last 18 weeks of your shared diary.
Three colors: you, them, and the days you both wrote.
It counts the days in a row, too.

#couples #couplegoals #sharedjournal #couplesapp #relationshipgoals #dailyhabits #DearApp
en.threads: Three colors, not one. On the Home tab, the days only one of you wrote look different from the days you both did. That difference is the point.
